title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：passage　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 passage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the guide ① cleared the passage that no traveller in the valley would have measured, and he said the clearing was the whole of the day. The ② passage, meaning the way itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed unmeasured in the book; a passage, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ passage in that valley had the same short map beside it, and the ④ passage at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A passage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the guide said the measuring is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the passage was the whole of the matter, meaning the progress and not the way. The ⑥ passage, meaning the progress and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; passage, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both a way and a progress. He said the progress is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ passage had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ passage of the whole thing, the guide wrote in July, was one valley and three days of measuring; passage, he said, is either the mark at the far ledge or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ passage I remember is the way measured in the guidebook, which closed in 1997 and is still measured as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ passage, my mother said in 1999, is the only way that improves by being measured; every passage, she said, is a progress that has agreed to look like a way. She said the progress was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 通道；段落（指山谷里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 通道；段落（指那条通道本身，与小小的地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the passage 疏通这一条通道
D. n. 通道；段落（指留给孩子们找的那一处）
E. n. 通道之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的通道之事）
F. n. 通道；段落（指旅行手册里写到、被测量的那一条）
G. n. 通道、进展（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 进展（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the passage that no traveller in the valley would have measured
The passage, meaning the way itself and not the map
the passage at the far ledge
the passage was the whole of the matter
the passage had become a line in a guidebook
The passage of the whole thing
A passage, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: clear the passage 意为“疏通这一条通道”，1990 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位旅人肯测量的一条通道做了一遍。
passage 意为“通道；段落”，指那条通道本身而不是小小的地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。
passage 意为“通道；段落”，指山谷里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
passage 意为“通道；段落”，指最远那处崖台的留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
passage 意为“通道、进展”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条进展就是那件事的全部。
passage 意为“进展”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条通道，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
passage 意为“通道；段落”，指旅行手册里写到、被测量的那一条，到 1995 年这一条成了旅行手册里的一行。
passage 意为“通道之事”，向导七月写道，整件事的通道之事是一处山谷和三个日子的测量。
passage 意为“通道；段落”，我记得的是旅行手册里测量过的那一条，1997 年走完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一条。
passage 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，通道是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的通道。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年那位向导疏通了山谷里没有一位旅人肯测量的一条通道，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（clear the passage）
那条通道，指的是那条通道本身而不是小小的地图，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被测量。（passage）
那处山谷里每一条通道旁边都有同一张小小的地图。（passage）
最远那处崖台那条通道，指的是他们留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（passage）
叔叔说这条进展就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那条通道。（passage）
1999 年母亲说，通道是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的通道。（passage）

The passage at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the passage was the whole of the matter, meaning the progress and not the way.
